protocol.renderStride: 1 up to 128; ceil((grid-1)/126) above 128; identical source indices in both modes
protocol.timing: Wall time for fixed numerical ticks, all required field uploads, uniforms, command encoding, render submission, and queue completion. Serialized completed frames, not browser FPS.

models.baseline: Exact JavaScript reference equations + three full float32 GPU field uploads per frame
models.candidate: linear-water-webgpu-f32-v1; six resident ping-pong fields; no ordinary state readback

protocol.control: Eight timings of 2,000,000 unchanged integer iterations before and after each process suite
exclusions: Nonlinear water, droplets, forcing and rigid coupling

gate.conclusion: Per-grid results apply only to this declared serialized workload. Small-grid losses are retained.
